title: The Smith-Morra Gambit
blurb: Answer the Sicilian with a pawn sacrifice. Open files, fast development, and traps on every move.

replies.idea: Take the centre.
Challenge the Sicilian's c5 pawn at once.
The Smith-Morra: offer a pawn for fast development and open files.
Recapture with the knight. You're a pawn down, but already developing.
Develop and cover d4 and e5.
The bishop aims at f7 and the weak e6 square.
